deduplicate_lib
===============

``deduplicate_lib`` is a Python library for finding and removing duplicate
numpy vectors in a dataset.  It provides exact and approximate deduplication
algorithms, along with tools for automatically selecting the distance threshold
(``tolerance``) that determines when two vectors are considered duplicates.
